REQ-1.description: Upload a receipt from the file picker, the camera (on mobile) or drag and drop; JPEG, PNG, HEIC and PDF are accepted, anything else is refused with a message.

REQ-2.description: Image clean-up before OCR: grayscale, contrast stretch and straightening (deskew), plus EXIF orientation and a size cap.

REQ-3.description: Text reading with Tesseract.js in the browser (Portuguese + English), in a Web Worker, with every asset served from the app's own origin.

REQ-4.description: A rule-based parser finds merchant, date, line items (with quantities and item discounts), subtotal, tax, tip/service and total, for Portuguese and English receipt formats.

REQ-5.description: The Portuguese fiscal QR code, when present, is read and parsed (date, merchant NIF, total, IVA breakdown) and used to check the parsed items against its total.

REQ-6.description: Review step: parsed items open in the M1 editor, with a live check of items against the receipt total, flagged low-confidence lines, and warnings.

REQ-7.description: Every receipt reader sits behind one shared interface (image in, structured receipt out), with QR checks and bill conversion shared, so later readers (bring-your-own-key AI, a hosted reader) can plug in without changes elsewhere.

REQ-8.description: A set of sample receipts runs through the real pipeline in tests: totals match, or the result is clearly flagged for correction.

REQ-9.description: Any parsing failure falls back to the manual editor, leaving the current bill untouched, instead of blocking the user.

REQ-10.description: No receipt data leaves the browser: the app stays a static client that never sends data (no fetch/beacon/socket code, form-action 'none'), self-hosted OCR/QR/PDF/HEIC assets, a production Content-Security-Policy limiting connections to the app's origin, a real-browser request log (URLs, methods, request headers and bodies, from the document and every worker) showing only same-origin GETs of the app's static files and no value from the scanned receipt during scans, and receipt images never stored.

REQ-11.description: README.md and app/README.md reviewed and updated for M2 (roadmap 'Every milestone'), ADR 0002 records the receipt-reading dependencies and their licences, and the vendored packages' licence notices (including LGPL-3.0 heic-to) ship with the app.

REQ-12.description: An end-to-end UI test goes from a scanned receipt through review to the split result.
